fields.source: Identify normalized-image handoff and Recognition Processing Contract V1.2
fields.fallback: No preview substitute; missing image returns to Capture.
fields.error_behavior: Do not start detector without image input.

fields.fallback: Stay in the current semantic state while the pipeline is active.
fields.error_behavior: A reported pipeline exception exits as TECHNICAL_FAILURE.

fields.source: Canonical Master Flow and recognition 3+2 decision authority
fields.fallback: No fabricated fish focus or candidate.
fields.error_behavior: NO_FISH, IMAGE_QUALITY_WARNING or TECHNICAL_FAILURE remain distinct exits.

fields.source: Real detector bbox through the displayed-photo transform; Processing Visual Spec V1.1
fields.fallback: If contour data is absent but bbox is valid, use only the source-authorized degraded level.
fields.error_behavior: No rectangle, halo or contour may imply a fish before a real focus region exists.

fields.source: Recognition pipeline result event; confidence thresholds remain current runtime authority and are not changed here
fields.fallback: No candidate/confidence is shown during Processing.
fields.error_behavior: A real classifier failure exits TECHNICAL_FAILURE.

coverage.empty: No normalized image means Processing is not entered; return to Capture.
coverage.loading: CAPTURED/DETECTING share one visible IMAGE_RECOGNIZING state. No fake progress percentage, ETA or rotating copy.
coverage.error: No Fish, Image Quality and Technical Failure use distinct exit contracts; no record is created in Processing.
coverage.partial: A valid detector bbox may use the registered degradation level when contour alpha is unavailable; classifier semantics do not change.
coverage.network_failure: If a real pipeline/network dependency reports failure, use TECHNICAL_FAILURE. Network errors are never represented as No Fish or Image Quality.

runtime_boundary: Design/State contract only. Recognition Design Closure V1.2 records runtime/evidence ACTIVE_CLOSURE.
